title: Make a thread looser or tighter (Offset Face)

steps.text: Pick the right body. Hide the lid (Locket) with its eye in the Browser: it sits inside the jar and hides the thread, so your clicks would land on it. A Section View helps you see the thread.
Start Offset Face and click anywhere on the thread (green): the rounded flanks and the wall between the turns both change the Thread step. Blue is the flat bottom, red is outside the part.

Type the distance. Minus removes material from the part you clicked (looser fit), plus adds material (tighter fit). The panel says "Thread 1: only Burk changes ...": only that part changes, the other one keeps its size. Press OK.

Result with the lid on (section view): before, lid (yellow) and jar (blue) touch everywhere; after -0.2 on the jar there is 0.2 mm of air between them, the lid is unchanged. It is an Offset Face step in the timeline, so you can edit it or undo it.
